svg.title: iPawcus: A Web-Based Veterinary Management System with Online Booking and Pet Record Management for Vetfocus Care Animal Clinic - Combined UML Sequence Diagram
svg.desc: Four role lifelines, iPawcus System and Database. Messages run top to bottom within guarded service alternatives. Large bold uppercase text. Named references retain supporting operations without activity-diagram symbols.
svg.text: IPAWCUS: A WEB-BASED VETERINARY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM WITH ONLINE BOOKING AND PET RECORD MANAGEMENT FOR VETFOCUS CARE ANIMAL CLINIC
FOUR INDEPENDENT ROLES; FOLLOW THE SELECTED SERVICE BRANCH, NOT EVERY OPTIONAL BLOCK.
R1: SIGN IN INDEPENDENTLY; AUTHORIZE EACH ROLE AND REQUEST
MANAGE ACCOUNTS, ROLES AND CLINIC ASSIGNMENTS
SET SITE ACCEPTANCE AND SEPARATE ONLINE SLOTS
REVIEW BOOKING / PAYMENT; CONFIRM OR ADJUST
SAVE FINDINGS / IMAGES / CONSENT; REASSIGN IF NEEDED / COMPLETE EXAM
FINALIZE DIAGNOSIS / TREATMENT; CONSENT IF NEEDED
R2: JITSI / JAAS MEETING ACCESS AND VIDEO CALL
RUN CARE JOB / ROOM STAY; RECORD CARE
R5: CARE UPDATES; VET REVIEW IF REQUESTED; DISCHARGE / PICKUP AFTER CHECKS
[DIAGNOSIS CONTAINS NEW / CHANGED MEDICINES (ONSITE OR ONLINE)]
SYNC PET PLAN / ITEMS; RETAIN VERSIONS
[OWNER STARTS AVAILABLE PRESCRIPTION ITEM(S), NEW OR EXISTING]
START ITEMS / ALL; DATES PER ITEM
POST CHARGES / VERIFY AND RECORD PAYMENT
[EACH DUE OCCURRENCE OF A STARTED PRESCRIPTION ITEM]
R3: VIEW / EMAIL RECORDS; CORRECTION: OWNER → ADMIN REVIEW → VET UPDATE → OWNER RESULT
R4: INDEPENDENT OPERATIONS: STOCK / SETTINGS / REPORTS / MONITORING / BACKUPS
R2: SUPPORTING SERVICES: LOCATION / NOTIFICATIONS / DOCUMENTS (INVOKED WHEN NEEDED)
SOLID FILLED ARROW: CALL | DASHED OPEN ARROW: REPLY | SOLID OPEN ARROW: UPDATE / HANDOFF
OPT: OPTIONAL | ALT: SELECT ONE SERVICE | LOOP: REPEAT PER DUE ITEM | REF: EXPLAINED IN THE ACCOMPANYING NOTES
